customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to install, with one noting it fits perfectly on wooden door frames, and appreciate its reliable performance with triple deadlocks for high security. The lock offers multiple unlocking options and provides a modern touch to the door, making it convenient for the whole family. While customers find it easy to use, opinions about the app experience are mixed.

reviews.title: Great Lock
reviews.body: Great job by Mr Bhim. Efficiently attached to door and all features explained very patiently

reviews.author: Ved
reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.body: Definitely a 9/10 lock. A couple of features could’ve been added like remote unlock without requiring the bell to be pressed but otherwise does all the work!

reviews.title: Best Lockpro by UC with latest features.
reviews.body: Very useful Digital lock especially for Sr citizens, who can operate with ease. It is safe & secured. We can see who is ringing our bell & can decide whether it is safe to open or not. It is also useful for young parents, frequent travellers & everyone. Now we can relax without any hesitation of leaving behind our valuables if any at home. I liked it.
